summary: Citius Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K disclosing a registered direct offering and concurrent private placement of common stock, pre-funded warrants, and common warrants to institutional investors. The offering involves 4,730,457 shares at $0.985, pre-funded warrants at $0.9849, and 5,076,143 common warrants exercisable at $0.86. This financing arrangement, while dilutive, does not represent a special situation as defined—there is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender offer, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The filing is a routine capital raise under an existing shelf registration.
